question: Which image model best paints the approved cast in the frozen storybook style?
why: Every later art run depends on this. Testing once now means we don't pay to find out later.
sameAcrossModels: Same design reference, same character descriptions and same style text. Only the model changes.
decideBy: You pick by eye: does it look truly painted and charming?
It honors the approved designs: the oversized coat, spectacles and logbook, fluffy Moth.
Faces and silhouettes still read at book size.
Clean edges on plain paper, so the piece can be cut out.
learnEvenIfRejected: Real credit cost and speed per model, which prompt wording works, and how each model handles a design reference.
reusableOutput: The chosen paintings become the master reference images for later poses and scenes. Rejected images stay as a record and aren't regenerated.

Hand-painted traditional watercolor with a fine graphite pencil outline, from a vintage natural history picture book. Soft pigment washes, visible paper grain, gentle edges. Natural animal anatomy, gentle and dignified, not a cartoon. One character only, full body, centered, on plain warm white paper. No scenery, no ground, no text.
